description: 한국철도공사_새마을 열차 운임표 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국철도공사. 이 데이터는 한국철도공사 홈페이지에서 제공하는 최신 새마을호 열차의 운임표로, 노선별 구간에 따른 요금 정보를 다운받을 수 있으며 다른 열차의 시간표 및 운임표 정보도 함께 확인할. The portal shows 2025-09-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
